Hero_Desc_BeniBeni:
Beni has grown a little more mature during her evacuation to the Witch Kingdom.
She learned how precious friends are and gained the attentiveness to consider another person's feelings.
Even while remembering everything she learned, her enduring innocence shines through.
Album_Like_BeniBeni: Helping with construction that requires strength
Album_Wish_BeniBeni: For everyone to return to the Beastfolk Village healthy and strong
Album_BeniBeni1: Beni seems to look a little different. She says the 'Sticker Witch' decorated her, and I think I know whose work this is.
Album_BeniBeni2: Even while staying in the Witch Kingdom, she apparently came up from time to time to collect honey. Her dedication to honey remains as steadfast as ever.
Album_BeniBeni3: She became lost in thought, saying that thinking too deeply might actually be bad. Has she ever thought too deeply about anything...?
Album_BeniBeni4: She maturely declared that friends must always be cherished. She looked proud as she said that even if they tease and fight sometimes, friends will always be friends.
Album_BeniBeni5: Working in the Witch Kingdom seems to have brought her closer to Picora and Snorky. It was endearing to see her proudly tell me how happy she was to be recognized as an excellent worker.
Album_BeniBeni6: After eating her fill in the banquet hall, she puffed out her cheeks and said she had missed all the food she could not eat in the Witch Kingdom. It seems she had a difficult time there.
Album_BeniBeni7: We promised to visit somewhere filled with honey together next time. When I asked whether that would be rude to Jubee, she pretended not to hear me.
LoveHero_BeniBeni: I am so happy you trust me, Master! I will do my very best!
LoveHeroCancel_BeniBeni: Uuuh... Am I still not good enough?
Food_ChefNote_BeniBeni_Hate1: She pushed the glass away, declaring that she would no longer be fooled by black drinks filled with ice.
Food_ChefNote_BeniBeni_Hate2: She puffed out her cheeks and said she had moved so many stones lately that she had no desire to eat one.
Food_ChefNote_BeniBeni_Like1: She emptied the entire jar, saying that no matter how many snacks she ate, this was the flavor she always craved for dessert.
Food_ChefNote_BeniBeni_Like2: She ate while humming happily, saying it tasted good, was nutritious, and would make an excellent gift.
Food_ChefNote_BeniBeni_Like3: She emptied the bowl, saying nothing could beat the feeling of warm, rich rice cake melting in her mouth.
Food_ChefNote_BeniBeni_Like4: She wondered why a house could not be built from this food, then happily devoured it, deciding she would think after eating because it was delicious.
Food_ChefNote_BeniBeni_Like5: She chewed it thoroughly, saying a handful during work made her feel refreshed.
Food_ChefNote_BeniBeni_Like6: She found the many flavors and shapes fun and fascinating, finishing them one by one.
Food_ChefNote_BeniBeni_Like7: She tried to swallow it whole, but after I stopped her, she slowly let it melt while savoring the flavor.
Food_ChefNote_BeniBeni_Like8: She asked why sour food made people feel energized, then swallowed the entire pile before hearing the answer.
Food_ChefNote_BeniBeni_Like9: The candies looked like many races gathered together and brought back memories, so she enjoyed them one at a time.

LoveLetter_BeniBeni:
Hello, Master! It feels like it has been a long time since I wrote a letter.
Writing down my feelings instead of speaking them still feels awkward.
But the village chief said that sometimes a letter lets you express your feelings more honestly...?
Though Beni is always honest anyway! Hehe.
In any case, thank you for everything, Master. Call me anytime you need my help!
Then I will see you next time!
LoveCall_BeniBeni:
Master! It is Beni~ Did you have another wonderful day?

I played a game of finding food in the village with Rufo, Boss, Kommy, and Butter!
While we were playing, my friends said they liked how Beni was still perfectly Beni.
When I heard that, I suddenly felt incredibly happy for no reason!

I hope not only I, but everyone can remain happy and get along together every single day!
That includes you too, Master! Hehe.
Going fishing with you, eating delicious food, and sometimes calling you like this! How wonderful would it be if these happy days continued tomorrow, the day after, and forever?
Thank you for always getting along with the same old, unchanging Beni!

Then I will call you again next time!

Affinity_BeniBeni_EP01_005: Hmm? I really am Beni, Master!

Affinity_BeniBeni_EP03_005: What? Surely not. Um... Though a Fairy wearing a hat did wake me when I slept on the road recently...
Affinity_BeniBeni_EP03_006: I am tired too. Perhaps I should close my eyes for a while.
Affinity_BeniBeni_EP03_007: Hmm! Excellent idea. A proper nap clears your mind and improves your mood.

Affinity_BeniBeni_EP04_002: That is fine. Be confident. Fashion is a feeling!

Affinity_BeniBeni_EP04_004: Honestly, I do not understand her either.

Affinity_BeniBeni_EP05_005: Potatoes are delicious too! Do you sprinkle yours with salt, Master, or sweet sugar?
Affinity_BeniBeni_EP05_007: Oh, really? Then what snacks do you like? I will bring some next time if I can!

Affinity_BeniBeni_EP09_001: Every day is enjoyable because I always live as myself!
Affinity_BeniBeni_EP09_002: Exactly! Beni being Beni is the most Beni thing of all.
Affinity_BeniBeni_EP09_003: Yes! Me being myself is the most myself I can... Hmm? Is that correct?
Affinity_BeniBeni_EP09_004: Not everyone can manage even that.
Affinity_BeniBeni_EP09_005: Hehe, hearing you say that is a little embarrassing. It is simply natural to me.
Affinity_BeniBeni_EP09_006: Come now, have you never acted unlike yourself even once?
Affinity_BeniBeni_EP09_007: Unlike myself? Um... I do not know! I have simply never thought about it.
Affinity_BeniBeni_EP10_001: Eating in the banquet hall is wonderful today too! How was your day, Master?
Affinity_BeniBeni_EP10_003: Hehe, hearing that you enjoyed yourself makes me happy too! What a relief!
Affinity_BeniBeni_EP10_005: Hmm, I think that is enough! I hope tomorrow will be even more enjoyable than today.
Affinity_BeniBeni_EP10_007: Master, I will cheer for you. Everything will work out! You are always doing your best.
